data.summary: All figures match NVIDIA's FY2024 results: revenue of $60.9B (+125.9%), gross profit of $44.3B (72.7% margin), operating income of $33.0B (54.1% margin), net income of $29.8B (+581.3%), and R&D of $8.7B vs. $7.3B. Diluted EPS of $1.19 vs. $0.17 is split-adjusted, and the original figures were $11.93 and $1.74. R&D growth of about 18% is only "modest" relative to revenue growth, but the operating-leverage conclusion holds.
